headlines.title: 경상흑자 386억 달러 ‘ 역대 최대 ’… K증시는 동반 하락 ‘변동성 극심...
headlines.summary: 5월 경상수지 37개월째 흑자 반도체 업황 피크아웃 등 우려 반도체 호황에 지난 5월 경상수지가 역대 최대 폭의 흑자를 기록했다. 8일 한국은행이 발표한 국제수지 잠정치에 따르면 5월 경상수지는 386억1000만 달러(약 58조6000억 원) 흑자로 집계, 직전 최대인 3월(379억3000만 달러)을 두 달 만에 뛰어넘었다.

headlines.summary: 연간 흑자 규모 2500억달러 웃돌 듯 경제성장률 전망 3%대로 상방 압력 고환율 국면 장기화할 가능성 높아 다음주 금통위서 기준금리 인상 전망 유성욱 한국은행 금융통계부장이 8일 오전 서울 중구 한국은행에서 열린 2026년 5월 국제수지(잠정) 설명회에서 발언하고 있다.

headlines.title: 정점 vs 저점 … 시험대 오른 ‘반도체주’ [이슈&뷰]
headlines.summary: 반도체 피크아웃 논란 다시 수면위로 ‘저승사자’ 모건스탠리 “주가 조정 온다” WSJ “오징어게임 같아” 변동성 우려 JP모건 “최근 조정, 저가 매수 기회” 국내 증권가 “다시 회복력 보일 것” 구윤철 “리스크 요인 면밀히 점검” 이달말 빅테크 실적·투자계획이 관건 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 코스피를 이끄는 반도체주가 진정한 시험대에 올랐다.

headlines.title: 삼전닉스 레버리지 ETF 상장가 붕괴 …‘ 매도 방어 ’ 개미도 역부족
headlines.summary: 변동성 장세 고민 깊어진 투자자들 단일종목 레버리지, 14개 중 13개가 하회 투자자예탁금 한달새 136조→112조 급감 반도체 업황 둘러싼 증권가 전망 엇갈려 한국 증시를 이끌고 있는 반도체 주가가 극심한 변동성을 보이면서 투자자들의 고심이 깊어지고 있다. 8일 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸에서 코스피 지수와 원/달러 환율이 표시돼 있다.

headlines.title: 반도체가 떠받친 경기 회복 … 수출 70%↑에도 제조업·고용은 부진
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 KDI, 경제동향 7월호 발표 AI 수요에 반도체 수출 179.6% 증가…설비투자도 9.7% 확대 서비스업 생산 4.9% 증가했지만 취업자 감소 전환 고용 둔화·고물가 부담 지속…"회복세 제약 가능성" 한국개발연구원(KDI).

headlines.title: “ 너무 비싸 못 먹겠소 ”… 한우도 미국산도 다 올랐다
headlines.summary: 도축물량 감소…한우 안심 1년새 18%↑ ‘환율부담’ 美·호주산도 20%이상 상승 한우 온·오프라인서 최대 50% 할인행사 소고기 가격이 외식 물가를 압박하고 있다. 도축 물량 감소와 고환율 영향으로 가격이 치솟은 가운데 정부의 장바구니 지원 정책에 관심이 쏠린다.

headlines.title: KDI 경기진단 '중동위험' 빼고 " 제조업 생산 조정·서비스 호조"
headlines.summary: "반도체 수출물량 증가세 조정…가격상승세로 수출호조 유지" "국제유가 하락에도 고환율로 물가상승률 둔화는 점진적일 듯" 반도체 공장 후보지 거론 (광주=연합뉴스) 정다움 기자 = 30일 오후 광주 김대중컨벤션센터에서 열린 서남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회에서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 호남권에 반도체 생산공장(팹)을 만들겠다는 투자 계획을 발표했다.

headlines.title: 6월 서울 아파트, 월세 8247건 > 전세 7108건
headlines.summary: 1년전엔 9586건 < 1만2997건 ‘전세의 월세화’ 현상 뚜렷해져 서울 아파트 임대차 시장에서 월세 거래량이 전세 거래량을 압도하는 ‘전세의 월세화’ 현상이 뚜렷해지고 있다. 불과 1년 전만 해도 전세 거래가 월세 거래에 3500건 가까이 앞섰지만, 올해 6월엔 거래량이 뒤집힌 데 이어 월세 거래가 전세 거래보다 1000건 이상 많았다.

headlines.title: “ 교부금 자동이체 그대로 둘 건가 ”…정부, 교육교부금 개편 논의 본격...
headlines.summary: 기획처 “내국세 자동연동 유지 어려워” 교육부 “소통없이 개편, 성장동력 흔들려” 학령인구 반영한 교부금 개편 원칙 제시 [헤럴드경제=양영경·김용재 기자] 정부가 학령인구 감소와 교육수요 변화에 대응하기 위해 지방교육재정교부금(교육교부금) 개편 논의를 본격화했다.

headlines.title: 석유 최고가격제 손실보전, 경제 잣대로 따져야 [현장에서]
headlines.summary: ■ 현장에서 검찰이 지난 6일 발표한 정유 4사의 유가 담합 의혹 수사 결과가 석유 최고가격제 손실보전 논의와 맞물리면서 정유업계가 술렁이고 있다. 검찰은 정유사들이 최고가격제 아래에서도 제조원가 기준으로 이익을 냈다며 ‘수조 원대 손실’은 과도한 주장이라고 봤다. 싱가포르 국제석유제품가격(MOPS)을 앞세운 손실 산정 논리도 ‘허구’에 가깝다고 봤다.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Exports Surge 179.6% Amid AI Demand, but Manufacturing and Employment Lag
key_headlines.summary: KDI reports semiconductor exports jumped 179.6% due to AI demand with capital investment expanding 9.7%, yet manufacturing production and employment show weakness despite service sector growth of 4.9%.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Current Account Surplus Reaches Record High, Growth Forecast Raised to 3% Range
key_headlines.summary: Expected annual current account surplus exceeds 250 billion dollars, prompting upward revision of growth rate forecast to 3% range, but persistent high exchange rates may trigger base rate increase next week.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse-to-Wolse Conversion Trend Accelerates in Seoul Apartment Rental Market
key_headlines.summary: Monthly rent transactions (8,247 units) now exceed jeonse transactions (7,108 units) in June, reversing a year-ago pattern where jeonse led by 3,500 units, signaling fundamental shift in rental market dynamics.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Koo Prioritizes Three Mega Projects and Honam Semiconductor Cluster Development

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy shows mixed signals with semiconductor exports and service sector driving growth, yet manufacturing and employment remain weak. The KDI reports semiconductor exports surged 179.6% on AI demand with capital investment expanding 9.7%, though service production grew 4.9% while employment declined. Current account surpluses continue hitting record highs exceeding 250 billion dollars, prompting upward revisions of 2026 growth forecasts to the 3% range. However, high exchange rates and price pressures persist, potentially constraining recovery momentum and likely triggering a base rate increase at next week's monetary policy committee meeting.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's current account surplus reached historic highs in May, driving upward revision of 2026 growth forecasts from 2.8% to 3% across major investment banks. The government faces dual challenges of managing high exchange rates while supporting economic growth through structural reforms and medium-sized enterprise support initiatives. Consumer prices are expected to rise gradually due to delayed effects of currency appreciation and ongoing geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East. The KDI expects semiconductor export volume adjustments while maintaining robust trends, with government focused on supporting business transformation and expanding demand in steel and materials sectors. Cultural exports also contributed positively, with Korean Wave exports increasing 16% year-over-year to 18.975 billion dollars.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean financial markets experienced extreme volatility on July 8th with both KOSPI and KOSDAQ triggering consecutive circuit breakers due to sharp selloffs, particularly impacting semiconductor stocks. Samsung Electronics fell 6% while broader indices dropped 3-5%, driven by foreign investor net selling continuing for 14 consecutive trading days and individual investors liquidating 753 billion won. The KOSPI and KOSDAQ breadth indicators deteriorated significantly alongside rising government bond yields as investors reassess semiconductor sector valuations amid peak-out concerns. Morgan Stanley warned of potential stock adjustments while JP Morgan characterized recent declines as buying opportunities, with domestic securities firms expecting recovery. Market sentiment hinges on end-of-month Big Tech earnings reports and investment plans.
sections.Industry & Technology: LG Energy Solution achieved Q2 operating profit turnaround at 113.3 billion won, signaling recovery from earlier losses driven by US Inflation Reduction Act tax credits and surging energy storage system demand. The company's recovery proves K-battery sector resilience despite global EV market slowdown, with LG Chem-GM joint venture Ultium Cells beginning LFP battery cell mass production for energy storage at Tennessee facility. Advanced Material investments are expanding beyond semiconductors to energy and infrastructure sectors as AI-driven investment patterns diversify beyond pure chip production. South Korea's digital industry revenue reached 1,378 trillion won in 2024, growing 9.3% year-over-year, with Daehan Electric winning 45 billion won Australian AI data center power infrastructure contract.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment rental market shows dramatic shift toward monthly rents with 8,247 transactions exceeding jeonse (long-term lease) transactions of 7,108 in June, reversing year-ago patterns where jeonse led by 3,500 units. Civic organizations report Seoul apartment rent and jeonse prices rose 8% during Lee Jae-myung administration's first year, prompting calls for expanded public housing supply with true public rental units representing only 4.4% of total housing stock. Small apartments under 60 square meters show competitive application ratios of 13.97-to-1, four times higher than medium and large units, reflecting affordability constraints driving demand shift. National apartment supply outlook index rose sharply in July on rising housing prices and intensifying jeonse shortages, with provincial markets like Gwangju gaining positive investor sentiment.
sections.International Economy: South Korea faces maximum 12.5% tariffs after expiration of Trump administration's global 10% tariff policy scheduled for mid-July. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Walsh's first FOMC meeting minutes were released July 8th, providing guidance on future interest rate direction amid supply shocks keeping inflation above the 2% target. Walmart's aggressive price reductions on cherries and cola drew Trump praise as inflation monitoring continues, while Dow Jones broke historical 53,000 level on semiconductor-driven rally. US economic growth reached 2.1% annualized in Q1 2026 driven by AI infrastructure investment, though benefits concentrated among high-income earners and AI company investors, widening inequality. OPEC+ production increases and international energy prices remain key factors for global economic outlook.
sections.AI & Economy: Financial AI agent LinkAlpha raised 34 billion won in Series funding from A.T. Num Investment and new backers including Korean Industrial Bank and IBK Corporate Bank. South Korea's digital industry reached 1.378 quadrillion won in 2024 revenue driven by AI expansion, with AI infrastructure development requiring increasing private loan financing according to BlackRock analysts. AI industry concentration in United States benefits primarily high-income workers and investors, with bottom 25% income earners showing lowest wage growth rates despite overall 2.1% economic expansion. Crime proceeds tracking AI systems process over 100 million suspected money laundering transactions annually, reducing analysis time and improving detection rates through automated financial intelligence analysis. Tech executives revised earlier claims of AI causing employment termination, acknowledging human talent remains critical with 85% of jobs created over 80 years attributed to technological advancement.
sections.Others: Government education financing reform maintains internal tax revenue linkage mechanism while redirecting surplus allocations to universities and early childhood education. Crime financial flow AI systems now automatically analyze over 133 million suspicious transactions annually, improving efficiency and detection accuracy in combating money laundering. Youth political groups propose establishment of 'Youth Special Fund' modeled on regional decline response programs to address demographic challenges. Consumer price index underwent revisions reflecting changing consumption patterns, with malatang and infant education fees newly added while peanuts and doraji removed effective December 2026 announcement. Incheon Airport celebrates reaching 1 billion cumulative passengers milestone, demonstrating recovery in international travel demand.
